newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Fahey says share worthless.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Fahey says share worthless.

text.p: Australian Finance Minister John Fahey said on Thursday the share interest he had failed to declare to parliament was worthless.
"We're down to pettiness and pedantics when it comes to something that is worth absolutely nothing," Fahey told reporters. "It's worth zilch."

Political interest in Fahey's undisclosed investment follows the resignation of two government members this week over conflicts of interest. Fahey has a registered share in a private company called Tunboa Pty Ltd, which he says provided secretarial services to his former legal partnership.
Faheye says he sold the share in 1986 but the buyer, his former partner, failed to register the transfer.
The Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Thursday that Fahey had continued to declare the share when he was a member of the New South Wales parliament.
Fahey told reporters he had continued to declare the share in state parliament by mistake.
